summary: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) amending Item 8.01 of its September 30, 2026 report concerning the tax-free distribution of MSGS Spinco, Inc. common stock to stockholders; post-distribution the registrant renames to MSG Knickerbockers Corp. and trades as MSGK. The amendment updates disclosure of overlapping executive officers and directors across the registrant, Spinco, MSG Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment and AMC Global Media, including James Dolan as Executive Chairman/CEO of the registrant and Spinco. No price, ratio, record or distribution dates, or advisor are disclosed. Watch for Form 10 registration effectiveness and NYSE when-issued trading as the arbitrage timeline signals.
